scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev .wrangler/pages-build
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run check:site && npm test
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run test:db && npm run check:workers
scripts.deploy:api: npm run check:api && wrangler deploy --config apps/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply intent-os-db --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply intent-os-db --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --local
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run check:site
